label: Offers
description: Manage sellable offers for marketplace and classic ecommerce use cases without discounts, orders, payments, delivery, or advanced inventory.

instructions: Apply the bundled Supabase schema and Edge Function to the configured project.
Create a dedicated bearer token and install it in both the CMS secret store and the Supabase function secrets.
Install the offers source and offers dashboard with the deployed function URL.
checks: The CMS only stores the source configuration and private API key reference.
Marketplace self-service writes force seller identity from x-cms-user-id.
The connector schema stays private to anon and authenticated Supabase roles.
This module does not own discounts, coupons, carts, orders, reservations, delivery, payments or advanced inventory.
resources: Generated private CMS offers API key
Private offers schema and Edge Function
review: Keep the offers schema private to anon and authenticated roles.
Use offer ids as the integration point for future carts, orders, reservations and payments.
Keep promotions and discounts in a separate module so base offer pricing stays deterministic.
Do not trust browser-provided seller ids for marketplace self-service writes.
ui.syncNote: This integration creates a stateless CMS source. Supabase owns offer rows and the cms-offers Edge Function owns access.
